chattranslator.settings.title: Chat Translator Settings
chattranslator.settings.system.tooltip: Also translate server announcements (Hypixel sends player chat as system messages too)
chattranslator.settings.item_name.toolti: Item names protected by a dictionary stay in English
chattranslator.settings.show_original.to: Show the original text faintly under translated tooltip lines
chattranslator.settings.general.note: Set shortcuts in "Key Binds…" (default: hold J to show the original tooltip)
chattranslator.settings.gpu.tooltip:
VULKAN: works on any GPU (recommended)
CUDA: NVIDIA only, faster (~580MB extra)
CPU: no GPU (slow)
chattranslator.settings.builtin.where: Stored in config/chattranslator/llama (starts when you join a world)
ON: format for translation models such as translategemma
OFF: for general models such as GPT or Gemini
chattranslator.settings.deepl.key: DeepL API key (free keys end with :fx)
chattranslator.settings.key.set: Set (…%s) — type only to change it
chattranslator.settings.cloud.note: Cloud APIs receive the text being translated and may charge for usage
chattranslator.settings.dict.note: Drop JSON dictionaries into the folder to add many terms at once (format: see README)
chattranslator.settings.cache.persist.to:
ON: reuse translations after restarting (item descriptions show instantly)
OFF: cleared when the game closes
chattranslator.settings.cache.note: Changing the engine, model or language keeps a separate cache automatically
chattranslator.settings.uilang.tooltip: Language of this mod's screens and messages. Key binding names in the Controls screen follow Minecraft's language
chattranslator.settings.backup.dictionar:
Enabled dictionaries, the user dictionary and your own dictionary files (the bundled Hypixel dictionary is not included)
On import the user dictionary is merged; other dictionaries with the same name are replaced
chattranslator.settings.backup.cache.too: Translation cache (%s entries now). Imported entries are added to the current cache
chattranslator.settings.backup.note: API keys and engine settings are not exported. To import a file from another PC, put it in the folder
chattranslator.dictedit.title: User Dictionary
chattranslator.settings.book.tooltip: Translates written books and lecterns. Hold J for the original. Pages with clickable text stay as they are
chattranslator.settings.send.tooltip: Translates what you type before sending it (set the languages and how to send on the "Sending" tab)
chattranslator.settings.send.confirm.too: ON: the translation is put in the chat box; press Enter again to send it. OFF: Enter translates and sends right away
chattranslator.settings.send.commands: Commands to translate (comma separated; "msg 1" keeps the first word, the recipient)
chattranslator.settings.send.note: Press Enter in the chat box to translate. Commands starting with / are translated only if listed above. If translation fails, press Enter again to send the original
chattranslator.send.review: Translation placed in the chat box. Press Enter to send
chattranslator.send.cancelled: Not sent (the chat box was closed or edited)
chattranslator.send.failed: Could not translate (%s). Press Enter again to send the original
